errors.evidence: The order of the categories on the x-axis is Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, Expository. This is not alphabetical order, which would be Argumentative, Descriptive, Expository, Narrative.
While the last labeled tick mark on the y-axis is 120, the axis range extends beyond this to accommodate the tallest bar, which has a value of 130. Therefore, the scale is not from 0 to 120.
The legend is located in the top center of the chart, not the top right corner.

The y-axis is described as being scaled from 0 to 120, but the visible axis range extends beyond 120 to accommodate data points with values of 122 and 130. The labeled tick marks are from 0 to 120, but the axis range is larger.
The description states the legend is in the top right corner, but it is located in the top center of the plot.
